title: Juicy Char Dutch Lamb Kebabs
description: A funky and velvety Dutch dish featuring char-grilled lamb, plain flour, and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, perfect for a monsoon evening.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the flour mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the lamb with olive oil and season with lemon juice.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
